subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram albums be automatic for existing sendMessage/mediaUrls payloads, exposed as a new explicit send-media-group action, or supported through both with a documented contract?
rationale: Current main already preserves multiple media URLs on the standard send path, while the open draft introduces a parallel action and filePaths parameter; that API choice affects prompting, docs, fallback behavior, and plugin contract stability.

options.title: Use existing mediaUrls
options.body: Implement sendMediaGroup for eligible multi-media sendMessage/mediaUrls payloads and fall back to existing sequential sends for non-groupable cases.

options.title: Accept explicit album action
options.body: Sponsor a separate send-media-group action only if maintainers want album sending to be opt-in and separately documented from normal sends.

options.title: Pause until contract is chosen
options.body: Keep the issue and draft PR open but ask contributors not to continue implementation until maintainers choose the permanent message-tool shape.

recommendation.title: Use existing mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Implement sendMediaGroup for eligible multi-media sendMessage/mediaUrls payloads and fall back to existing sequential sends for non-groupable cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already drove the prior cleanup review and has the strongest recent history across the Telegram send/action surfaces.
